column1: # TiDB v8.5.5 token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# terminal whose %token declaration in parser.y does not spell it. Keywords and
# operators need no row. Sources: pkg/parser/lexer.go and pkg/parser/misc.go.
# (empty) is a token written as nothing; (unreachable) is a token the default SQL
# mode never lexes, so the alternatives that need it get hand-added rows.

column3: an exponent makes it a float; without one TiDB lexes a decimal
a lexer error token; no sentence reaches it
optimizer hints are comments to the grammar
|| as concatenation needs PIPES_AS_CONCAT; the default mode lexes pipesAsOr
high-precedence NOT needs HIGH_NOT_PRECEDENCE; the default mode lexes not
builtinX: a function name read right before '('
